metadata.description: Validation test for arming (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T07): on the ground, arming is refused with the throttle up, with the rescue or hold switch on, and on the first arming with 7 satellites; it succeeds with 14 (home taken), and a re-arm with 7 succeeds without a home. A DROP failsafe disarms, and arming then needs the switch cycled. fc_warnings shows each reason.
